s.note: Jimmy's video business for the dying
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water, peel and halve. Mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp pickle juice, salt and pepper until smooth. Pipe back into the whites and finish with smoked paprika and chopped chives.

s.note: Colorado green chile, with chips for dunking
s.how: Melt 250g white American cheese with 125ml milk over low heat, stirring until smooth. Stir in 1 can (120g) chopped roasted green chiles, 1 crushed garlic clove and 1/2 tsp ground cumin. Simmer 2 minutes, pour into a warm bowl and serve straight away with 200g corn chips.

m.note: the diner booth where the job gets planned
m.how: Cook 2 sliced brown onions in butter over low heat for 25 minutes. Shape 600g beef mince into 4 thin oval patties and sear 2 minutes a side. Butter 8 slices rye bread on the outside, fill each sandwich with a patty, onions and 2 slices Swiss cheese, and griddle in butter until crisp and melted.

w.note: Colorado dessert for Jimmy's last good night
w.how: Mix 250g plain flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp salt, 30g butter rubbed in and 180ml warm water into a soft dough. Rest 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick and cut into 16 squares. Fry at 180C until they puff and turn golden, about 1 minute a side. Drizzle with 120g honey and dust with cinnamon.

d.how: Toast 30g desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden, cool on a plate. Wet the rims of 4 glasses with a lime wedge and dip in the coconut. Blend 200ml white rum, 240ml pineapple juice, 160ml coconut cream, 30ml lime juice and 4 cups ice until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses, add a pineapple wedge and a cocktail umbrella.
